The measuring stick

Austria assignments — January 2026

Eleven tasks handed over at the workation in Austria. These are the items the quarterly checkpoint on 25.09.2026 walks through.

2 Delivered
4 In progress
2 Solved differently
1 Waiting
1 Parked
2 Not started
  1. 01 SOLVED DIFFERENTLY

    Children's area windows

    Insulation impossible before building works. Heater installed by the parents' seating instead; sign to follow.

  2. 02 WAITING

    Routesetting course

    State funding needs AZAV certification, heavier than assumed. New path: a sport-education student on placement.

  3. 03 NOT STARTED

    Morning climbing-fitness courses

    Plan expanded: take over the whole course area, three age tracks, one trainer, written training plans.

  4. 04 SOLVED DIFFERENTLY

    Merchandise

    Own import dropped on liability and testing costs. New model: consignment with a small European brand plus two partner days a year.

  5. 05 DELIVERED

    Corporate identity guideline

    27-sign system designed and installed. Coral, cream, ink, Baloo 2, sector naming.

  6. 06 IN PROGRESS

    Plakate and spider web

    Wayfinding concept complete: one mother Plakat at the entrance, child Plakate leading through the gym.

  7. 07 NOT STARTED

    Presentation of our products

    Held back on purpose until the course offer under item 3 settles.

  8. 08 IN PROGRESS

    Plakat placement per customer group

    Seven-station journey mapped: entrance, changing, warm-up, beginner wall, Muscle Island, bistro, closing.

  9. 09 NOT STARTED

    Promoting what we already have

    The problem is the hidden campus: outdoor area, children's house, spray wall and training gym are invisible in winter.

  10. 10 PARKED WITH A PLAN

    Slab of the Week

    Blocker was extra setting labour. Fix: one fixed sector, one setter, one fixed day inside the existing rotation.

  11. 11 IN PROGRESS

    Griptonite monthly competitions

    Second box and second TV installed, summer league ran as a live test. Monthly format still to be written.
